topicName: AoS1 Study Piece: Beethoven Symphony No. 1

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The opening starts on a dissonant dominant seventh of F major — not the tonic C major — a deliberate subversion of Classical expectation.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The slow introduction (Adagio molto) delays the allegro, building anticipation before the first theme group enters in C major.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Beethoven's development section is unusually dramatic for a first symphony — he pushes harmonic and dynamic boundaries beyond Haydn's models.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The orchestration follows the Classical model but with Beethoven's characteristic weight: prominent winds, dynamic brass, and driving rhythmic energy.
